title: Haul-Away Crew Extra on the Late-Change Goodwill Refund
content:
**Rule.** For the late-change goodwill refund of a Northgate Scheduled Large-Item Delivery order under **Northgate Store and Online Orders**, the old items booked for haul-away are counted as the haul-away charge before benefits divided by the program's haul-away fee per item (25.00 for Northgate Scheduled Large-Item Delivery), and they add:

| Old items booked for haul-away | Extra percentage |
|---|---|
| two or more | 10 percent |
| one | 5 percent |
| no haul-away | nothing |

**Hypothetical booking.** A haul-away charge of 50.00 before benefits is two old items and adds 10 percent, even where a benefit lowered the amount actually charged.
